items.q: How can I find a customer's order?
items.a: Open Orders, then search by order number, customer name or phone number. Select an order to review its items, delivery address, payment details and status history.

items.q: Where can I check delivery information?
items.a: Open the order detail page. The Deliver to section shows the address captured when the customer placed the order.

items.q: What do the order statuses mean?
items.a: Placed means the order was received; Confirmed means accepted; Packed means prepared; Shipped or Out for delivery means dispatched; Delivered means completed. Cancelled, rejected and returned orders appear with their final status.

items.q: How do I update product stock?
items.a: Open Stock alerts or Products, enter the new whole-number quantity and save. The stock history records the change.

items.q: When is a product marked low stock?
items.a: A product is low stock when its quantity is above zero and at or below its configured low-stock threshold. Zero quantity is out of stock.

items.q: Can I change the low-stock threshold?
items.a: Yes. Open the product editor and update its low-stock threshold. The alert status is recalculated from the new threshold.
Review the payment status and payment records on the order detail page. Only mark payment received after confirming that the money has actually arrived.
Follow the store's approved refund process with the payment provider, then ensure the order status and payment record reflect the completed refund.

items.q: How do I update a product?
items.a: Open Products, search by name or SKU, and choose Edit. Save the changes to update the catalogue.

items.q: How do I hide a product without deleting it?
items.a: Use the product visibility control to hide it from the storefront. This preserves the product record for later use.
